name: bison_bulls_locked
description: Two American bison bulls head to head in a rut shoving match: left one facing right, right one facing left, foreheads pressed together at (0,-200), horns overlapping but nothing hooked, hind legs braced back, dust puff at the front hooves. Shoving, not goring. Anchor bottom-centre, x -620..+620, y -420..0.
